tier1.notes: Installs in a few seconds from the app, no card removal. The receiver now checks for a Remote ID module at start-up and reports what it finds, the same way it reports which radios, AHRS and pressure sensors are present -- previously a receiver with a module fitted reported that it had none unless a setting was turned on by hand. Detection is based on the module reporting in, so a receiver without one still reports none. Remote ID is not a shipping feature yet. Includes everything from 0.24.72: the receiver's EFB licence controls third-party EFB software over WiFi, while our own apps are always served over WiFi and Bluetooth whether licensed or not, and Bluetooth is never restricted.

tier2.notes: Write this to the card for the complete release. Your settings do NOT survive a reflash, so you will run first-time setup again -- and that includes the EFB licence, so a re-imaged receiver needs activating again before third-party EFB software will work. Download the .img.xz to a computer and write it to the microSD card with BalenaEtcher. Do not decompress the file first.
